title: When the Protocol Turns
author: Wendell Pemberton
blurb: Mara Lockridge, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
